confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are based on aggregated guide and crowdsourced figures (Numbeo-style, Expatistan, combien-coute.net, Where and When) for Bulgaria and Plovdiv in 2026, which vary noticeably between sources. Plovdiv is typically cheaper than Sofia, so the values lean toward the lower end of the Sofia and seaside ranges. Cocktail and wine were estimated from the local beer relationship because direct data was thin. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context; no booking pages or current listings were checked. Bulgaria adopted the euro on 1 January 2026, and USD values assume a EUR-to-USD rate near 1.15.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: lower-cost mid-sized Southeast European cities, with Plovdiv set below Sofia and close to Bulgarian seaside-resort restaurant levels. Drink anchors use the beer price as the reference point for cocktail and wine, since direct Plovdiv data was weak.
